resource.name: Lodge
resource.creator: bashframes
resource.description: Mac camera-card ingest with custom names, incremental copies and SHA-256 verification. Standalone companion with a paid license and trial.
resource.platformNotes: Universal Apple Silicon/Intel app; macOS 14+. Provider says the app is not notarized. No independent offload or data-integrity test.

requirements.dependencies: Removable-volume access; optional daily update check can be disabled.
requirements.installation: Mac DMG; follow the original unsigned-app installation instructions.

evidence.note: Universal Apple Silicon/Intel app; macOS 14+. Provider says the app is not notarized. No independent offload or data-integrity test.

Mac camera-card ingest companion that copies into custom folder/file templates, skips previously copied media and verifies each copy with SHA-256. Reads the card without overwriting destination files. Use before importing footage into an editor; this is a standalone offload utility rather than a Resolve plugin.
Original product page explicitly identifies Lodge 1.0; release date not established.
